scope_issue: The timing range is approximate. Some failures (E-0101) have no stated time to failure, and E-0103 is just past two years. Some product types are implied by the thread rather than named. The reports come from self-selected complaint threads and give no failure rate.
reasoning: In three threads (18nj9sk, bqe83z, 1lfsxia), several distinct owners report zipper, strap or fabric failures on Nordace backpacks, with timings from under a month (E-0078) to about two years (E-0012, E-0031, E-0103). E-0035 does not describe a failure, and E-0090 is only a partial fit. The contradicting reports of long use do not refute that these failure reports exist, and the scope limits already acknowledge them, so the pattern as worded holds.

scope_issue: None of the supporting evidence backs the clause 'others report quick replacements'. Among the contradicting items, E-0092 reports a free zip replacement with no speed stated, and E-0084 reports a wrong packing-cube bundle corrected immediately, which is not a bag replacement. E-0049 describes policy rather than an attempted return.
reasoning: Two buyers (E-0036, E-0074) describe being offered a 30% partial refund or paying return shipping themselves, and E-0049 cites a buyer-pays-shipping policy, so the first half is supported. The second half, about quick replacements, has no supporting evidence. The contradicting items only weakly suggest it: one free replacement with no timing given, and one quick fix of a wrong accessory. E-0003 involves a full refund on a cancelled order and does not support the claim.
